sceneConcept: A slightly plump forty-four-year-old Chinese engineering-section chief stands alone against a transparent background. Short black hair greys at the temples, and rectangular glasses sit above a mildly sheepish round face. He wears a pale blue civil-service work shirt with sleeves rolled to the forearms, dark trousers, a simple belt, wristwatch and brown shoes. Most of the shirt is tucked neatly into the trousers while exactly one front-right corner hangs loose outside the belt. Both hands rest in his trouser pockets. Soft even frontal studio light keeps the small disorder visible.
naturalLanguageDetail: A slightly plump forty-four-year-old Chinese engineering-section chief with a mildly sheepish face stands with both hands in his pockets, wearing a pale blue rolled-sleeve work shirt whose body is tucked neatly into dark trousers except for exactly one front-right corner hanging loose outside the belt under soft even frontal studio light.
